entry.title: New: Resolution 49 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT OF SCHLACK ITO, A LIMITED LIABILITY LAW COMPANY, AS SPECIAL COUNSEL TO CONTINUE TO REPRESENT THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI IN HUI MALĀMA HONOKŌHAU VERSUS COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI, CIVIL NO. 1:23-CV-00393

Extends the retention of Special Counsel Services with additional compensation of $300,000 and total compensation not to exceed $500,000.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 49-25 & GOEAC-12 - 1/22/25
